phases.name: Foundation and platform build matrix
evidence: CI run 44954098299 passed Windows, Linux, Android arm64, ASan/UBSan and TSan.

phases.name: Persistence and reliable HTTP engine
evidence: HTTP HEAD/Range 0-0 probing, parallel libcurl range transfer, bounded byte-range scheduler and tail work stealing are implemented. Retry integration and process-kill journal recovery remain pending.

Commit 45ff568 adds bounded exponential retry/backoff around probe and transfer attempts. Commits d9db677 and 1a6ee1c add non-truncating partial-file reopen and ordered segment journal query; c49cebc adds unit coverage. Full crash-recovery coordinator remains pending.

Commits a1581f7 and 7f1c8fc implement journal missing-range planning and a recovery coordinator; commit 95e728c adds an end-to-end recovery fixture. Commit 6276848 plus b3f4376 enforce/test fsync-before-SQLite journal ordering.

Important limitation: startup resets stale Downloading tasks to Queued, but the segment-journal recovery coordinator is not yet connected to the main download worker's actual partial files. Full crash-resume remains incomplete.

Commits 8d0e0b4/1e7f30a/3b2ce7d wire stream metadata, completed-range flush-before-SQLite checkpoints, exact Content-Range validation and recovery of missing byte intervals into DownloadQueueWorker. Commit b6f8a91 preserves partial files on cancellation and 14c35a9 persists only durable bytes.

Commits 8d0e0b4/1e7f30a/3b2ce7d wire stream metadata, completed-range flush-before-SQLite checkpoints, exact Content-Range validation and recovery of missing byte intervals into DownloadQueueWorker. Commit b6f8a91 retains preallocated partial files on cancellation.

phases.name: yt-dlp extraction and toolchain
evidence: Commits dc4b5fe/7227084 add a shell-free process runner with bounded output and hard timeout; 5f31e16 adds yt-dlp JSON/playlist parsing; 3fe5ee7 adds persisted profiles; 9c499ac adds SHA-256 verification and rollback-safe activation; 3af7137 adds expired media URL refresh. Acceptance tests are authored but not yet executed.
Commits 733214c, c8b94cf, 9a9d6ed and 59b18e3 add HLS playlist/AES-128 metadata and DASH SegmentTemplate/Timeline/List/Base parsing. Parser acceptance fixtures added in e8dbfeb/bc69b0c; CI pending.

Commit f1948e8 adds media extraction queueing behind an active yt-dlp profile; 2f0537d/a75b224/c2b3127 execute the selected yt-dlp binary or Python module in the worker with cancellation, output verification and playlist mode. 657cc4e adds profile configuration UI and 39b4ad2 reports capability in handshake.

phases.name: HLS DASH and muxing
evidence: Commit 74a1112 adds a shell-free ffmpeg stream-copy mux service with optional subtitle mapping and metadata/chapter preservation. HLS/DASH manifest parsing remains pending.

phases.name: Application services and browser host
evidence: Desktop Native Messaging frame reader baseline exists; Android loopback API and foreground service remain future requirements.
Android ad-blocking requirement clarified: original Raymond Hill uBlock Origin via official Firefox for Android add-on; embedded GeckoView remains an unverified optional path.

Commits 648e46a, 338dc2f and 3409aaf make Native Messaging add_download/add_batch/chunk completion persist queued SQLite records and selected queue IDs before positive ACK. Acceptance fixture in 745dcbf.

Android-only Qt Network loopback server now binds 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port, authenticates with a per-launch 256-bit key, handles preflight/health/IPC, and persists add_download/add_batch/chunk-complete requests to the app SQLite database. UI exposes port/key for Firefox Bridge setup. Foreground service, task-control/status push and on-device E2E remain pending.

Commits 650334f/06ed117 add a background task worker with cancellation; f75eb79/b18ba69 expose progress callbacks; 4de4d17/070e44d persist throttled byte progress; 1ba47d9/7a02f8f implement pause/resume/cancel dispatch; 6b28592/981eed0 add queue CRUD/default queue migration; 34e1a01/5158035/6c60a8e add queue/task UI.
Queued yt-dlp media extraction is executed by the background worker; Bridge popup no longer asks for cookies it cannot use and disables extraction until a profile is active. Commit 12b40ac.

Worker now calls recover_download_segments for preallocated partial files on resume/restart; otherwise clears stale journal and starts a safe full transfer. Integration tests are authored; execution deferred to final validation.
Android MediaStore export on API 29+ added in commit 10273fb; API 28 SAF/legacy export and device acceptance remain pending.

Commit 6ca522b adds user-scoped Windows/Linux Native Messaging host registration/uninstall scripts; e236a92 aligns the registered host name with Bridge's com.vortexdm.native_host; d57fdaf adds installation instructions.

phases.name: Responsive UI and release
evidence: Optional Qt QML shell added; responsive mobile UI and release artifacts remain pending.
User-supplied VortexDM artwork added as Qt application icon resource; commit fd96c2f.
Commits a1666c1 and 18826ee add an Android package manifest, dataSync foreground-service Java class and JNI startup hook. Device/API-level acceptance and signed APK build are still pending.
Commits f0f71d5/131f93f add responsive Android layout and yt-dlp profile feedback. Commit 10273fb adds MediaStore export for completed files on Android 10+; API 28 remains private-only.
